title: Funny Last-Place Flag for Fantasy Football Punishment
description: Big, bold, and painfully honest — a flag made to shame the season’s worst performer. Design created with AI-assisted design and finished by Last Place Outfitters. This item is printed to order by a trusted third-party print partner. The flag is double-sided, works indoors or outdoors, and does not include a flagpole or mounting hardware. Perfect as a humiliating gift for draft-day losers, backyard displays, or the office desk shame ritual.
rationale: Scoreboard style and a high-contrast orange palette make the three short lines instantly readable from a distance. Phrases are goofy but specific — ironic ‘legend’ plus ‘pity cup’ and the cheeky ‘ask me how’ invite teasing and storytelling.
